title: The Morning Digest: October 24, 2026
dek: Brent Dec26 settled Friday at $116.72 (up $3.55, or 3.14 percent), its highest settle since April 29, and WTI Dec26 at $103.27 (up $3.80), closing weekly gains of about 6.2 and 4.3 percent. Heating oil settled essentially flat, so the completed diesel crack eased to $105.66. Houthi claims against an airport and a refining complex in Saudi Arabia on Friday are unconfirmed; the coalition confirmed one interception. The Revolutionary Guards' seven-vessel claim has had no corroboration in three days. The US Department of Energy authorized an emergency exchange of up to 400,000 barrels of reserve crude to a Louisiana refinery on Friday, citing a supply disruption it did not describe. WCS Dec26 settled at -$27.85 (ICE TMW settle, Oct 22), the most recent settlement file available for this edition.
